title: Triggered modifiers
source: LoadTriggeredModifiers (0x5BD90) reads the file into CTriggeredModifier, whose LoadKey (0x5BAC0) takes `potential` and `trigger` (each a CAndTrigger) and passes every other key to CModifier::LoadKey: `icon` and the modifier names (FINDINGS-triggereval.md, CTriggeredModifier). Every entry is tested once a day for every country, in file order, `potential` and then `trigger` (FINDINGS-countrymodifier.md section 3); an entry of the same name as another is a second entry, not a replacement.

file.desc: modifiers that apply to a country while their conditions hold

patterns.desc: a triggered modifier; its name is its localisation key

triggered.desc: a triggered modifier: conditions, then `name = number` pairs

potential.desc: country conditions for the modifier to be considered at all; a country failing them is not listed

trigger.desc: country conditions for it to apply; the panel's `n / m` counts these

icon.desc: the frame of the modifier icon strip shown for it
